run_mrp_script_launch_processes: run a Python script that uses mrp to launch and manage multiple processes including Docker and Conda runtimes
run_mrp_cmd_up: run mrp.cmd.up to start a named process with optional wait and attach flags
run_mrp_cmd_down: run mrp.cmd.down to stop a named process and wait for it to shut down
run_mrp_import_msetup: run mrp.import_msetup to load process definitions from an msetup.py file in the given path
run_mrp_process_definition: run mrp.process to define a named process with a Docker, Conda, or Host runtime and configuration
